title: PixelKin - The Farlamp Relit (intro, minor)
_note: Play-once head of farlamp-relit: the hymn's first line in D minor, hushed - a lone bell carries the tune over a soft harp and a low held bass; the strings swell in on the last two bars into the light. 84 BPM, 3/4, 8 bars. Stitched to farlamp-relit-loop.
